questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests basic observability, safe auto-remediation, and IAM trust for SAP on EC2. 

## Key Concepts
- CloudWatch Logs integration for SAP trace data
- VPC Flow Logs for network visibility
- CloudWatch alarms + Lambda auto-remediation
- Safe-guards to avoid restart loops
- IAM role permissions for logs and EC2 commands

## Code Example
```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  SAPRemediationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: '/'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SAPRemediation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:SendCommand
                Resource: '*'
  SAPRemediationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt SAPRemediationRole.Arn
      Runtime: nodejs14.x
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          const AWS = require('aws-sdk');
          exports.handler = async () => { console.log('Restart SAP HANA if needed'); };
  SAPHANA_CPU_Alarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: SAPHANA_CPU_Alarm
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/EC2
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref SAPInstance
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 80
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !GetAtt SAPRemediationFunction.Arn
```

## Code Example

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  DRTestEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      InstanceType: t3.medium
      ImageId: ami-placeholder
  DRTestRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      Name: dr-test.example.com.
      Type: A
      SetIdentifier: DRTestEndpoint
      Failover: SECONDARY
      TTL: 60
      ResourceRecords:
        - !GetAtt DRTestEndpoint.PublicIp
      HealthCheckId: !Ref DRTestHealthCheck
  DRTestHealthCheck:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HealthCheck
    Properties:
      HealthThreshold: 1
      Type: HTTP
      FullyQualifiedDomainName: dr-test.example.com
      RequestInterval: 30
```
